name: Can custom framing accommodate built-in shelving, niches, and wall blocking?

mainEntity.name: Can custom framing accommodate built-in shelving, niches, and wall blocking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom framing allows you to build architectural elements that standard layouts lack, such as recessed shampoo niches in tiled showers, arched entryways, tray ceilings, and structural pocket door pockets. It also enables the installation of solid interior blocking inside walls, which is essential for securely mounting heavy bathroom grab bars, floating vanities, upper kitchen cabinets, and wall-mounted plumbing fixtures. Addressing these details during the initial carpentry phase ensures long-term stability and a clean, precise fit for finish surfaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, custom framing incorporates structural blocking for cabinets and grab bars, as well as rough openings for recessed niches, pocket doors, and decorative ceilings.
